infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Echo Finders uses the camera so you can hold up your phone and see which echoes are around you.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Echo Finders uses your location to find the echoes around you and to start each one as you reach it. Your exact location stays on your phone.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: So echoes can start on their own as you reach them, with your phone in your pocket and the screen off, during a hands free walk you start. Echo Finders works without this: keep it on screen while you walk and echoes will still open. Your exact location stays on your phone.
